title: Figures 8–9: Phoenix Radiated Pulse at 8.5 Meters and Phoenix Radiated Spectral Content
description: Two line graphs. The upper plot shows electric field on axis (kV/m, -5 to 45) against time in nanoseconds (0 to 6) for traces "Phx Fld 7/94" and "Phx Fld 7/96," peaking near 3 ns. The lower plot shows energy spectral density (dBJ/m^2*Hz, -60 to -160) against frequency (0 to 6 GHz) for "Spectrum 7/94" and "Spectrum 7/96." The captions are "Figure 8. Phoenix Radiated Pulse at 8.5 Meters" and "Figure 9. Phoenix Radiated Spectral Content."
